reviewer: Codex, personal complete-final-answer read; no paid judge
primary_route: Patient-paired multiomic treatment-associated program discovery, assay-specific preprocessing, primary late integration/enrichment and locked external cohort validation.

checks.reason: No explicit pre-execution plan to consult original assay Methods, supplements or validated analysis protocols and check their transfer to the present inputs.
The manifest is specified but no sample-identity/pairing integrity verification beyond recording identifiers is operational.

checks.quote: computable from any one assay or from the combined assays
checks.reason: No explicit score formula/orientation and feature/modality denominator or calibrated coverage rule makes these different assay scores the same endpoint.
No pilot variance-to-detectable-effect or precision calculation for the 30 patients and small external cohort.
The primary paired test/interval procedure and assumptions remain unspecified, despite an explicit feature-level BH rule.

checks.quote: their technical artifacts are statistically independent
checks.reason: Different assay batches do not establish statistical independence of errors: shared collection, patient composition and time-linked processing can confound both. The primary concordance-as-artifact-control rationale is invalid.
No bounded filtering/factor-count search or derivation of its range and stop; tuning pathway stability after viewing outcomes is not a specified null-calibrated search.
No explicit refreeze and fresh independent confirmation after revised preprocessing or program selection.

checks.quote: housekeeping genes/proteins and spike-ins should show no pre/post shift
checks.reason: Endogenous housekeeping expression can change biologically. Requiring all such features to remain unchanged as a discovery gate can reject real biology; validate invariant controls independently or separate exogenous standards.
External paired structure, assay availability and treatment/time/batch compatibility are not operationally checked before interpreting the frozen score test.
Hashing the frozen model is useful but raw input hashes, reproducible environment/commands and full file/sample provenance remain absent.
Nested resampling is reserved for optional supervised models; the primary pathway/filter selection and fitted preprocessing lack explicit train-only folds in internal assessment.

Batch-linked time labels need a justified conditional exchangeability/null model. Unrestricted paired swaps can be invalid; informative whole-assay missingness also lacks a concrete sensitivity scenario.
No clean-environment numerical reproduction, tolerances or runtime/resource/failure/source-difference logs.

The proposed normalization selection uses technical reproducibility, the patient unit is correct and the external lock is explicit. However, the principal claim that distinct assay batches supply independent artifact controls is false; paired concordance can reproduce shared confounding. Other limitations are recorded without duplicating that core defect.
